4RoHOKUgYNEB6K0TmLiK.definitionOfDone: Perform test, provide feedback and measure to Alberto
4RoHOKUgYNEB6K0TmLiK.description:
Ventilated Cabinet motor works full speed unresponsive to input. Company technician provide feedback remotely and ask additional test to isolate the problem and help find the solution.
The idea is only to verify two things:
1.	Power supply of the transmitter, Measure between +24V and GND, Expected value: approximately 24 V DC
2.	Output signal of the transmitter, Measure between SIGNAL OUT and GND
We are not looking for a precise calibrated value. What we need to know is simply:
•	if the signal is present and changing slightly while the cabinet is running (normal behavior), or
•	if the signal remains completely fixed or close to 0 V, which would strongly indicate that the pressure transmitter is faulty.
Link -> https://istitutoitalianotecnologia-my.sharepoint.com/:i:/r/personal/alberto_galbusera_iit_it/Documents/Documenti/Ventilated-Cabinet_test.png?csf=1&web=1&e=AsMT1w

Eqkg5zfMhcapUabCITZm.definitionOfDone:
- there is an updated design that accounts for MRI-compatibility and placement of the bifurcated cable + mirrors
- there is a 3D print of the animal cradle, ready to use
Eqkg5zfMhcapUabCITZm.description:
We need an updated version of the WFI/MRI headpiece prototype that accounts for the placement of a bifurcated fiber bundle and 2 additional 90° mirrors. In addition the fastening system between lower and upper part should be changed to an MRI-compatible locking solution instead of the magnet solution we have now, so we can start testing the compatibility of all the intended components used at the headpiece. 
Another point to consider is, that currently we are always imaging with a slight angle (achieved with layers of tape) so we don't get glare from the implanted glass. For the future it could be helpful to have a way to adjust the angle if necessary? (But this is not a requirement, only if its easy to implement)
Eqkg5zfMhcapUabCITZm.lastComment: The cardle is the main challenge of the mechanical system, im going to put L level of difficulty, to make it reliable, MRI compatible and has to interface with the optical systems and all the instruments we use inside the MRI (heated bed, temperature, ventilation, optics, vibrations, breathing pad and so on)
